# nb-studio follow-up

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## follow-up follow

Follow an issue in my follow-ups

Adds the issue to the ones the caller follows, after the others; following it already changes nothing. At most 5: past that the caller unfollows one first (`FOLLOWING_LIMIT_REACHED`). An issue newly followed counts what happens on it from now on. `issueId` is an id or an identifier. Needs `pm.issues` view.

```bash
nb-studio follow-up follow <issue>
```

| Argument | Description                     |
| -------- | ------------------------------- |
| `issue`  | The issue, by id or identifier. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/followUps/issues/{issueId}/follow` (`followUpsFollowIssue`)

## follow-up list

Get my follow-ups

The issues the caller owns that are in review, blocked, in progress or in backlog, and the issues they follow (at most five; by default their blocked and in-review issues, newest first), each with what it waits for now and, for a followed one, how many comments and changes others made since the caller last looked at it. Needs `pm.issues` view.

```bash
nb-studio follow-up list
```

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `GET /api/followUps` (`followUpsGet`)

## follow-up unfollow

Stop following an issue in my follow-ups

Takes the issue off the ones the caller follows; not following it changes nothing. `issueId` is an id or an identifier. Needs `pm.issues` view.

```bash
nb-studio follow-up unfollow <issue>
```

| Argument | Description                     |
| -------- | ------------------------------- |
| `issue`  | The issue, by id or identifier. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/followUps/issues/{issueId}/unfollow` (`followUpsUnfollowIssue`)
